title: Dreamcoder Deployment Profile
description: Repository-safe deployment profile. Deployment profiles describe supported platforms and rendering settings only; they never contain device addresses, usernames, hostnames, keys, tokens, or host runtime state.

name.description: Unique deployment profile name (e.g., desktop-arch, mobile-termux).

description.description: Human-readable description of the deployment target.

platform.description: Supported deployment platform. termux-mobile targets Termux/Moshi.

os.description: Human-readable operating system label; never host-specific details.

terminal_default_mode.description: Default Dreamcoder color mode for this deployment.

herdr.description: Repository-safe Herdr rendering settings only; never runtime state.

ui.description: Rendering-only [ui] settings for generated Herdr variants.

pane_scrollbars.description: Herdr [ui] pane_scrollbars; mobile keeps pane scrollbars disabled.

notes.description: Free-form deployment notes without sensitive material.
